snippet.title: The Croods: First Official Gameplay Trailer! Out March 14!
snippet.description:
The Croods game will be available as a free download on Android & iOS devices from March 14! http://rovio.com/thecroods

From the creators of Angry Birds and the creative minds at DreamWorks Animation: a FREE new game based on the upcoming motion picture phenomenon!
